TransformationExample.cpuCount: Number of CPU cores, minimum value is 1
TransformationExample.memoryCapacity: Memory size in GB, minimum value is 1
TransformationExample.volumeCapacity: Storage size in GB, minimum value is 1. If the disk type diskIoType is cloud\_enha, volumeCapacity must be greater than 50
TransformationExample.allocatedMemoryInMB: Memory size in MB, minimum value is 1
TransformationExample.nodeAmount: Number of proxy instance nodes. This parameter can be omitted if the resize type is not for proxy nodes. If resizing proxy nodes, the value must be one of (2, 4, 6, 8, 16)
TransformationExample.isDirectPay: Whether to pay directly, defaults to false. Resize orders set to direct payment will be charged immediately without going through the payment process
TransformationExample.isEnhanced: Whether it is an enhanced edition RDS
TransformationExample.effectiveTime: Execution method, with two values: timewindow and immediate. timewindow means execution within the time window, immediate means immediate execution. Defaults to immediate. The default time window for an instance is 05:00-06:00; refer to the instance details for specifics
TransformationExample.masterAzone: The master availability zone to change during resize. This parameter requires a value, e.g., cn-bj-a. If not provided, the current master AZ is used by default
TransformationExample.backupAzone: The backup availability zone to change during resize. This parameter requires a value, e.g., cn-bj-a. If not provided, the current backup AZ is used by default
TransformationExample.diskIoType: Storage disk type, including four types: local SSD disk (value: normal\_io), enhanced ESSD cloud disk (value: cloud\_enha), high-performance cloud disk (value: cloud\_high), and general-purpose cloud disk (value: cloud\_nor)
TransformationExample.subnets: Required when the master or backup availability zone needs to be changed during resize
